name: start-gate-allows-listed-starter
description: A class with an explicit allowlist (platformAdminsMayStart: false, onlyStartersInteract: true) admits a listed starter end to end: the session starts, the agent answers. This is the non-misfire control for the start gate — the refusal path is proven by the agentsession integration test against real SpiceDB, and a refusal bundle joins the scenario set once the fake channel kind renders metaagent notices as posts.
